system.description:
You infuse chakra into a chakra seal as you attempt to mark a person with the seal of binding. A creature within range, must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save the target creature is Restrained for the duration and gains 1 rank of Sealed.

A creature Restrained by this jutsu remakes their save at the end of each of their turns.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of targets by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, it can be cast as a Reaction, when you see another creature casting a Jutsu with a Mobility (M) component. When Cast this way you can only target one creature and the jutsu ends at the end of that creatures turn.
